required_fixes: Fix decision-rule gap: frozen spec defines only SURVIVES_REVERSAL_PERSISTS (requires NC2/F3 PASS), FALSIFIED_REVERSAL_ARTIFACT, UNEXPECTED_BOTH_TRUE, MEASUREMENT_INVALID — no handling for MIXED where reversal direction persists (F1 not triggered, F2 not triggered) but quantitative reproduction fails (NC2 FAIL, F3 TRIGGERED). Amend spec to explicitly define MIXED outcome and its claim ceiling before any SURVIVES promotion.

Fix or justify quantitative reproduction thresholds: NC2/F3 0.05 threshold fails (deviation 0.07) and canonical deviation 0.0424 exceeds parent B1 0.02 threshold despite claimed identical corrected implementation (sorted roles + direct estimator). Either relax thresholds with principled justification (estimator-change tolerance) or align code to parent corrected implementation; current deviation (0.0424 canonical, 0.07 per-task) exceeds frozen tolerances and makes SURVIVES impossible as written.

Correct M14_def_form_only_ordering matches_parent claim: producer reports M14 [cart,product_listing] matches_parent true, but parent EXP-INTEL-35262261436 M7 is [product_listing,cart,detail] (product_listing top). Independent recompute with producer definitions gives cart>product_listing>detail for DEF-FORM-ONLY, contradicting parent. Freeze exact definition logic (role inclusion sets for DEF-FULL-MAP, DEF-FORM-ONLY, ISOLATED-A-LINK) and update M13-M15 matches_parent flags to reflect true correspondence; ordering wording in provenance/spec must match code.

Align measurement_validity estimator wording: spec claims 'direct 499500-pair estimator' but code implements within-iteration C(3,2)=3 pairs mean across 1000 iterations (provenance notes estimator 'direct 499500-pair (C(7,2)*C(3,2)=63 pairs per iteration)' is inaccurate for 7 tasks/3 definitions). Freeze operational definition (within-iteration definition-pair agreement vs null-ordering-pair agreement) consistently across spec, prereg, provenance and code before full-DOM rerun.

Document per-task weighted weighting semantics: spec says 'weighted by task density' and provenance says weighted by elements_with_bbox, but code weights as (density * elements_with_bbox/total_weight) normalized within page-type. Freeze explicit formula (weighted average denominator, per-type normalization) and commit canonical analysis script at stable repo path with hash before next frozen rerun.
